zephaniah.1.p1.b1.text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:

zephaniah.1.p1.b2.text: I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth

zephaniah.1.p1.b3.text: I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea … I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth

zephaniah.1.p1.b4.text: “I will stretch out My hand against Judah and against all who dwell in Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests—

zephaniah.1.p1.b5.text: those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven, those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Milcom,

zephaniah.1.p1.b6.text: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of the LORD is near

zephaniah.1.p1.b7.text: “On the Day of the LORD’s sacrifice I will punish the princes, the sons of the king, and all who are dressed in foreign apparel.

zephaniah.1.p1.b8.text: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.

zephaniah.1.p2.b1.text: On that day … a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.

zephaniah.1.p2.b2.text: Wail, O dwellers of the Hollow, for all your merchants will be silenced; all who weigh out silver will be cut off.

zephaniah.1.p2.b3.text: And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency

zephaniah.1.p2.b4.text: who say to themselves, ‘The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.’

zephaniah.1.p2.b5.text: They will build houses but not inhabit them, and plant vineyards but never drink their wine.

zephaniah.1.p2.b6.text: The great Day of the LORD is near— near and coming quickly. Listen, the Day of the LORD! Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter.

zephaniah.1.p2.b7.text: That day will be a day of wrath … a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness

zephaniah.1.p2.b8.text: a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities, and against the high corner towers.

zephaniah.1.p2.b9.text: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy …
